items.title: Micron, Qualcomm, Nova, Lattice Semiconductor, and Workday Shares Are Soaring, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks jumped in the afternoon session after Treasury yields retreated below 5% and oil prices declined, sparking a recovery across growth-oriented equities following the Federal Reserve's interest rate increase.

items.title: Stocks Rally, Shaking Off Fed’s Rate Hike
items.summary: Major stock-market indexes rallied, reversing the declines that followed the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate hike Wednesday.  The PHLX Semiconductor Index rose 3.1% after comments from Intel Chief Executive  Lip-Bu Tan  about soaring memory prices.  The Securities and Exchange Commission cleared a path for trading venues to offer tokenized stocks in the U.S., a landmark decision that may overhaul traditional equity markets.

items.title: AMD Leads Chip Stocks Higher Amid Sector Rebound
items.summary: The Philadelphia semiconductor index, known as SOX, rose for the third straight session Thursday. AMD stock was among the big gainers.

items.title: Why Micron Stock Is Jumping as Intel CEO Warns on Memory Chips
items.summary: Micron Technology  stock was back on the rise early Thursday.  A warning from the head of  Intel  about soaring memory prices looks to be reminding shareholders of the company’s profit potential.  Micron shares were up 5.3% at $975.86 in Thursday afternoon trading.
